question: How many EV two-wheeler scooters will be sold in India next year (2027)?
idealClarificationQuestions: Only registered EV scooters (vehicle registrations) or include unregistered low-speed (<25 kmph) vehicles? Assume registered only.
Personal use only or include B2B (delivery fleets)? Include both.
Geography: pan-India including all states? Yes.
Are we projecting market growth over current year? Yes — taking FY27 forward.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down growth model: total 2W market size → current EV penetration → projected next-year penetration based on YoY growth trajectory and policy push (FAME, state subsidies).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total 2W sales in India FY26 (estimate): ~20M units (recovery from FY24 trough of 17.5M).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual growth rate of EV 2W: ~35-40% YoY (driven by Ola Electric, TVS iQube, Bajaj Chetak, Ather, plus B2B fleets like Zypp, Yulu, Swiggy/Zomato delivery).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Projected EV penetration FY27: ~10-12% → 2.1M to 2.5M units.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Take midpoint: ~2.2M EV 2W units in FY27.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~35-40% YoY (driven by Ola Electric, TVS iQube, Bajaj Chetak, Ather, plus B2B fleets like Zypp, Yulu, Swiggy/Zomato delivery).

calculationFlow: Current EV 2W penetration in 2W sales: ~7-8% in 2026 = ~1.4-1.6M units.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Take midpoint: ~2.2M EV 2W units in FY27.
